subject.title: Slack: support assistant.threads.setSuggestedPrompts for dynamic prompt suggestions

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable and dynamic Slack assistant suggested prompts now, and should the dynamic surface be Slack-only or a portable channel/message-action API?
rationale: Current code already has fixed default prompt seeding and the Slack API helper, but the remaining request changes public config and agent-facing action contracts.

options.title: Design API Boundary First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the stable config shape and dynamic action boundary before implementation.

options.title: Implement Slack-Only Prompts
options.body: Add a Slack-owned prompt config and dynamic action with schema, docs, and tests, accepting the Slack-specific public surface.

options.title: Keep Fixed Defaults
options.body: Treat current fixed prompt seeding as the supported behavior and close only after maintainers explicitly reject configurable or dynamic prompts for now.

recommendation.title: Design API Boundary First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the stable config shape and dynamic action boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history on the Slack assistant lifecycle and related config/action boundaries.
